name: Storage water heater [tank water heater]
definition: water heater that heats and holds water in its own tank.
notes: Rheem listed with gas, electric and hybrid water heaters beside tankless

name: Tankless water heater [instant water heater]
definition: water heater that heats water on demand as it flows.
notes: Navien tankless condensing and non-condensing; Stiebel Eltron CF Plus tankless

name: Heat-pump water heater
definition: water heater that heats water with a compressor heat pump (C10(b), CV-24).
notes: Navien sells NWP500 Series heat pump water heaters

name: Solar water heater
definition: system that heats household water from solar collectors.
notes: ThermoPower VTS thermosyphon kits sold as solar hot water systems

name: Solar thermal collector
definition: flat-plate or evacuated-tube collector sold on its own (B7-O1).
notes: Apricus sells flat plate and evacuated tube collectors; VTS evacuated tube collectors listed

name: Point-of-use water heater
definition: small water heater fitted at one tap or outlet.
notes: Bosch Tronic 3000T and Stiebel Eltron SHC mini-tank under-sink heaters

name: Hot-water cylinder
definition: indirect or buffer tank heated by a boiler, with no heat source of its own (B7-O1; provisional until attested as a retail kind).
notes: Unvented cylinders sold direct, indirect (boiler coil) and heat pump; cylinder is the retail unit

name: Water softener
definition: unit that removes hardness from the home supply; salt-based or salt-free is a technology attribute.
notes: Waterdrop WHR01 Water Softener System listed

name: Plumbed water filter
definition: filter plumbed to the supply or fitted to a tap; whole-house, under-sink, shower or tap-mounted is an installation attribute (a jug filter is B5).
notes: Whole-house and under-sink filter systems listed; pitcher and countertop also sold

name: Reverse-osmosis system
definition: unit that purifies water through a reverse-osmosis membrane.
notes: Waterdrop X Series and G3 reverse osmosis systems listed

name: UV water treatment system
definition: unit that disinfects water with ultraviolet light.
notes: Viqua S8Q-PA whole-home UV disinfection system

name: Distiller
definition: appliance that purifies water by boiling and condensing it.
notes: Megahome countertop distiller boils and condenses water

name: Bathtub
definition: fixed or freestanding tub for bathing in; era and material are attributes.
notes: Kohler alcove baths; freestanding and drop-in also sold; whirlpool is a feature

name: Shower
definition: shower unit or set for washing under running water; power source is an attribute (electric shower provisional as a kind only on a ranking source).
notes: Wickes sells mixer, electric and digital showers; Triton electric shower

name: Washbasin
definition: basin for washing hands and face; sold built into its cabinet is an attribute (K-184).
notes: Wickes full pedestal washbasin; semi pedestal and wall-hung also sold

name: Cistern-flush toilet [water closet]
definition: toilet flushed by water from a cistern.
notes: Wickes close coupled toilet pan with cistern

name: Waterless or composting toilet
definition: toilet that uses no flush water, composting or storing the waste.
notes: Sun-Mar composting toilets, electric and non-electric

name: Bidet
definition: separate low basin for washing the lower body.
notes: Kohler Amaretto bidet fixture sold under Bidets, vitreous china

name: Warm-water toilet seat [bidet seat; Washlet]
definition: powered toilet seat with a warm-water wash (rule R, C11).
notes: TOTO WASHLET warm-water bidet seat replaces a toilet seat

name: Hard-shell hot tub
definition: hot tub with a moulded rigid shell and built-in heater and pumps; construction material is an attribute (B-26; provisional).
notes: Caldera acrylic hot tubs in four series

name: Inflatable hot tub
definition: portable hot tub with an inflatable body and plug-in heater pump (B-26; provisional).
notes: Bestway Lay-Z-Spa Vegas AirJet inflatable hot tub

name: Wood-fired hot tub
definition: wooden tub heated by a wood-burning stove (B-26; provisional, mapping checked at harvest).
notes: Kirami wood fired hot tub with heater and chimney kit

name: Portable sauna
definition: sauna that is set up or folded inside a home, not a cabin standing as a building (K-64).
notes: Wayfair Portable Saunas category: steam tents and far infrared

name: Solar panel
definition: photovoltaic module that turns sunlight into electricity.
notes: Solar Panels collections by wattage; A1 lists panels from many brands

name: Plug-in balcony solar kit [Balkonkraftwerk]
definition: panel plus micro-inverter sold as one set to plug into a home socket and feed the grid, with no storage (B-25, S3a).
notes: Balkonkraftwerk complete sets of modules, micro inverter and mounts; some sold with storage

name: Off-grid solar kit
definition: panels, charge controller or inverter and usually a battery, sold as one kit to power a place without a grid connection; RV, van, boat and cabin are use tags (section 14; provisional until the kit page itself is fetched).
notes: Off-Grid Solar Power Systems and Kits with inverter, battery and panels; RV kits separate

name: Small wind turbine
definition: wind turbine sized to generate power for a home or site.
notes: Small wind turbines: Whisper (Southwest Windpower) and Air (Ryse Energy)

name: Inverter
definition: device that converts DC from panels or batteries to household AC.
notes: Off-grid, hybrid and grid-tie inverters from EG4, Sol-Ark, OutBack, Victron

name: Charge controller
definition: device that regulates charging of a battery from solar panels.
notes: Solar Charge Controllers collection, MPPT and PWM

name: Home battery
definition: rechargeable battery that stores electricity for a home; the portable power station (battery and inverter in one carried box) is its portable form (K-157; provisional as a retail kind).
notes: Battery collections (EG4, HomeGrid Stack'd); portable power stations sold separately

name: Energy meter or monitor
definition: device that measures and shows a home's electricity use or generation.
notes: Monitors and Metering collection: battery monitors, system monitors, shunts

name: Replacement air filter
definition: filter made to fit a purifier, humidifier or dehumidifier (S3).
notes: Levoit Core 300 Original replacement filter, fits named purifiers only

name: Softener salt
definition: salt used up in a water softener (S3, K-11; dishwasher salt is B6).
notes: Diamond Crystal Bright & Soft; product type Water Softener Salt

name: Replacement filter cartridge
definition: cartridge made to fit a water filter or treatment unit (S3, K-11).
notes: Aquasana replacement post-filter cartridge; Waterdrop replacement filters listed

name: Solar panel mount
definition: mounting frame or bracket made for solar panels (S3).
notes: Solar Rackworks DPW roof and ground mounts and pole mounts for modules
